newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia to build golf courses along Adriatic.
newsitem.headline: Croatia to build golf courses along Adriatic.

text.p: Croatia is planning to build golf courses along its Adriatic coast, including Dubrovnik, in order to upgrade its tourist facilities, deputy Tourist Minister Velimir Simicic said on Friday.

"We are interested in attracting foreign investors for the projects of building golf coursees along the coast in order to extend our tourist season beyond three summer months and to upgrade our offer," Simicic told Reuters over the telephone.
The ministry is currently in talks with British hotel operator Rocco Forte about building two golf courses outside Dubrovnik.
A team hired by Forte has recently visited the Konavle area south of Dubrovnik, and identified five possible locations for the project.
The ministry on its part is expected to complete a feasibility study in the next month or so.
If an agreement was reached, Forte would find investors and provide the know-how for the construction of the golf courses.
Simicic refused to comment on the value of the project, but a Zagreb daily Vjesnik put the price of building a golf course at $5-7 million.
Forte was also said to be interested in a contract to manage a four-star Hotel Croatia in Cavtat, south of Dubrovnik, and to invest in its upgrading.
